scope: Functional McKernel OS/apps and Rust/assembly migration only; no security testing.

compiler_proposal.cpu_slot: background owner allocation required; no assumed CPU grant
compiler_proposal.reference_run: Same exact artifact on ordinary Linux, separately granted and captured; exact frozen bytes/exit0; no oracle inferred from reference stdout.

steps: After ordinary source/compiler/ELF/reference approval and execution, owner snapshots source/oracle/exact executable and captures to fresh repository export. Bind every runtime artifact by SHA256, size and stable identity. No host-preparation runtime path may enter a container manifest.

Reuse existing native_diagnostic_stager.py/native_diagnostic_overlay.py final-map and source identity joins; payload snapshot in export becomes apps/app. Preserve actual matched image, mcexec, modules, loader/libc and collector identities.

Use retained ND_PROCESS_EXEC_WAIT collector profile for parent/child oversubscription and original no-ND_FUTEX STREAM_LIMIT1024. Its app A empty B argv is acceptable: these apps ignore argv. Manifest must freeze exact same argv.

Bind manifest stdout_limit_bytes=1024 and stderr_limit_bytes=1024, exactly equal collector stream.limit; exact stdout_hex from primary-oracle and empty stderr, exit0; require EOF, no truncation/discard and observed=retained.

Keep existing payload10s timeout and owner physical teardown/postjoin controls. Parent/child schedule and syscall logs must be consumed by a reviewed lifecycle evaluator. Generic native_diagnostic.py currently asserts exactly one schedule event: do not use that as proof for a child workload or weaken its oracle. Reuse/qualify the accepted process235 lifecycle evaluator under owner review before release.
Use same one-heavy4CPU/12GiB/512task campaign grant; source-only preparation creates no compiler/staging/native/cleanup authority. Retain first failure and all originals.
